Brush JavaScript/WebAssembly runtime.
Built from ArthurBrussee/brush compatibility commit 3b80985709e2ec04fd6c8622a40e36473647a8e0.
360GS extension: v0.3c9 source-position holdout, BA/SfM hybrid seeds, GPU-only bounded Gaussian growth, and adaptive convergence stopping.
The browser growth path performs no training-time pruning, no argwhere/readback, and no bounds recomputation.
Growth remains device-capped at 36k/50k/60k and scheduled approximately every 1600 iterations with 5-8% additions.
SH degree remains 0 for controlled comparison with c7/c8.
wasm-opt disabled in CI because --converge exceeded hosted-runner time limits.
